nodes.name: KYB case identity
nodes.summary: Accept only tenant and case identity; the subject and every record come from the canonical case store.

nodes.name: case.create
nodes.summary: Create an idempotent synthetic case with immutable invocation provenance.

nodes.name: decision.policy.resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve the admitted effective tenant policy snapshot.

nodes.name: Company registry lookup
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:companies-house:business.registry.lookup; write the normalized RegistryRecord, Entity, Party records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: LEI lookup
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:gleif:reference.identifier.lookup; write the normalized Entity records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Officers lookup
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:companies-house:business.officers.lookup; write the normalized Entity, OfficerRole records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Ownership discovery
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:opencorporates:business.ownership.discover; write the normalized OwnershipInterest, ControlRight, Entity records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Document evidence package
nodes.summary: Acquire through evidence:package; write the normalized DocumentVersion, DocumentPage, Evidence records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Identity acquisition barrier
nodes.summary: Wait for every acquisition; a failed provider stays visible as a rejected settlement and its records are simply absent (the skill then reports CONTEXT_MISSING).

nodes.name: entity.resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve by corroborated identifiers; name similarity alone leaves candidates unresolved.

nodes.name: entity.match
nodes.summary: Compute transparent pairwise name/identifier features; score is uncalibrated.

nodes.name: registry.company.verify
nodes.summary: Verify captured legal status only when registry coverage is complete.

nodes.name: document.classify
nodes.summary: Classify supported text documents using pinned keyword rules, retaining unknowns.

nodes.name: document.fields.extract
nodes.summary: Extract explicit label:value text fields with exact source character spans.

nodes.name: document.evidence.link
nodes.summary: Verify assertion values against exact document-version character spans.

nodes.name: document.classify.catalog
nodes.summary: Classify each document version into the document field catalog by exact title, name and alias matches with spans; ambiguity stays UNKNOWN.

nodes.name: document.fields.contract_extract
nodes.summary: Extract every field of each classified document's catalog contract through an admitted provider, then validate schema, spans and source binding deterministically.

nodes.name: document.validity.assess
nodes.summary: Assess issue and expiry dates at the invocation's as-of time with their stated precision; an absent or partial date stays undetermined, never invented.

nodes.name: document.consistency.assess
nodes.summary: Detect a subject's field stated with different values, across document versions or within one, with every conflicting assertion and its source reference.

nodes.name: party.profile.build
nodes.summary: Assemble sourced party profiles while retaining distinct relationship roles.

nodes.name: ownership.graph.build
nodes.summary: Build a sourced directed multigraph with explicit cycle reporting.

nodes.name: ownership.interest.calculate
nodes.summary: Calculate exact path products; cyclic/unaccounted interests remain unresolved.

nodes.name: ownership.ubo.resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve individual UBO candidates using configured interest and control rules.

nodes.name: ownership.ubo.verify
nodes.summary: Corroborate owner identity through admitted evidence and allowed verification methods.

nodes.name: OpenSanctions sanctions screen
nodes.summary: Acquire through opensanctions:sanctions; write the normalized WatchlistEntry, ScreeningHit or NegativeSearchEvidence records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: OpenSanctions PEP screen
nodes.summary: Acquire through opensanctions:pep; write the normalized WatchlistEntry, ScreeningHit or NegativeSearchEvidence records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Adverse-media screen
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:complyadvantage:screening.adverse_media; write the normalized AdverseMediaEvent or NegativeSearchEvidence records, or an evidence gap when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Screening acquisition barrier
nodes.summary: Wait for every acquisition; a failed provider stays visible as a rejected settlement and its records are simply absent (the skill then reports CONTEXT_MISSING).

nodes.name: screening.sanctions.execute
nodes.summary: Evaluate admitted sanctions search records, retain candidates and identify incomplete subject coverage.

nodes.name: screening.pep.execute
nodes.summary: Evaluate admitted pep search records, retain candidates and identify incomplete subject coverage.

nodes.name: screening.adverse_media.execute
nodes.summary: Search captured media subjects while retaining allegations and negative scope.

nodes.name: screening.match.disambiguate
nodes.summary: Recommend review/false-match based on explicit contradictory identifiers.

nodes.name: risk.customer.assess
nodes.summary: Calculate a pinned weighted score with unknown factors retained and no acceptance decision.

payload.description: Scope EDD under the pinned policy, collect and review supporting evidence, obtain the required acceptance approval and record current control assessments before resuming.

nodes.name: edd.trigger.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluate explicit EDD trigger predicates and preserve unknown inputs.

nodes.name: case.context.hydrate
nodes.summary: Return the admitted context manifest without recursive compilation.

nodes.name: case.tasks.plan
nodes.summary: Compile stable tasks and explicit prerequisites from a workflow definition.

nodes.name: evidence.provenance.attach
nodes.summary: Attach source/version hashes to evidence; reject absent source identifiers.

nodes.name: evidence.sufficiency.assess
nodes.summary: Assess evidence coverage against explicit pinned requirement IDs.

nodes.name: quality.findings.verify
nodes.summary: Validate finding citation existence; semantic truth remains a separate review.

nodes.name: decision.requirements.compile
nodes.summary: Compile requirement applicability with explicit unknown conditions.

nodes.name: decision.rules.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluate pinned allowlisted rules; unknown inputs never produce PASS.

nodes.name: decision.approval.route
nodes.summary: Find independent policy-authorized approvers for an action.

nodes.name: decision.disposition.record
nodes.summary: Record a human-approved disposition only with satisfied acceptance controls.

nodes.name: Independent approval: decision.disposition.record
nodes.summary: The skill's payload is a proposal until a different, authorized human approves it (library approval flow).

nodes.name: Release approved effects: decision.disposition.record
nodes.summary: Commit the skill's held effects after an approval (re-validating case sequence and expiry), or discard them after a rejection; an external action without an outbound route stays a pending intent.

payload.description: Perform the policy-scoped periodic CDD review; reassess material changes and retain the evidence and authorized outcome.

nodes.name: monitor.customer.schedule
nodes.summary: Persist an idempotent next-review schedule using the configured interval.

nodes.name: KYB stopped for handoff
nodes.summary: A library success condition did not hold (EDD required, evidence insufficient, rules not PASS) or a human rejected the disposition; the case stays open for workflow handoff.

nodes.name: KYB result
nodes.summary: The last library step's output, reached only after the independent approval of the disposition.

metadata.name: KYB synthetic
metadata.objective: Run the financial-crime skill library's 29-step synthetic KYB workflow on the platform: connectors acquire data into canonical records, library skills reason over them, and an independent human approves the disposition. Synthetic reference only; not production-qualified.
